## 6247 N Rockwell St — Zoning & Development Evaluation
**PIN:** 13012120030000 | **Parcel resolution:** authoritative

---

### 1. Zoning District

This parcel is zoned **RS-2** (Residential Single-Unit, Detached House district) [3]. RS-2 is the second-lowest-density single-family tier, distinguished primarily by minimum lot area and FAR requirements [3].

**Verify:** [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning) or contact the Department of Planning and Development.

---

### 2. Can You Build a Two-Flat Here?

**Likely no — not as of right in RS-2.** The RS districts are intended primarily for detached houses on individual lots [3]. A two-flat (two-unit building) is an RT district use type [3]. There is a narrow exception under [2]: in the RS3 district, the minimum lot area per unit may be reduced to 1,500 sq ft to allow a two-unit building when 60% or more of the fronting block has been improved with multi-unit buildings, or the property falls within the "Predominance of the Block" boundary — but this exemption is **RS3 only**, not RS-2. Your parcel is RS-2, so this exemption does not apply.

**Confidence:** High that a two-flat is not permitted by right in RS-2. To pursue two units, you would need a rezoning to at minimum RS-3 (with the 60% block condition) or RT-3.5/RT-4.

**Verify:** [2] (§17-2-0303-B); also consult the Department of Planning and Development for rezoning feasibility.

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards (RS-2)

The retrieved code text does not include the full RS-2 bulk table (FAR, height limits, exact setbacks, and minimum lot area per unit for RS-2 specifically) — the zone_definition field was not returned in this query. Based on what is in context:

- **Minimum lot area per unit:** RS-2 has a higher minimum lot-area-per-unit than RS-3; the exact RS-2 figure is not in the retrieved text [2], but the general rule is that all R-district development is subject to minimum lot-area-per-unit standards and that other factors (parking, height, lot configuration) may further constrain achievable density [2].
- **FAR and height:** Not determinable from the retrieved code text for RS-2 specifically — the zone_definition was unavailable.
- **Off-street parking location rules:** Parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line; it may be placed in a required side setback only when accessed by a permitted driveway from the front [4].
- **Lot context:** The assessor records show a **4,125 sq ft lot** and a **1,661 sq ft building** (1 story, built 1925).

**Verify:** Full RS-2 bulk standards are in §17-2-0400 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance (not retrieved here). Request the zoning schedule from DPD or review the [Chicago Zoning Ordinance online](https://chicago.gov/city/en/depts/dcd/supp_info/chicago_zoning_ordinanceandlandusetables.html).

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit-Related Reduction

Off-street parking for residential uses in RS districts must be located on the same zoning lot as the dwelling units served [4]. Parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line [4].

The parcel **is not in a TOD area** and has no transit-served parking reduction available. The nearest CTA rail is the Morse Red Line station (1.71 miles away) and the nearest Metra stop is Peterson/Ridge on the Union Pacific North line (1.04 miles away) — both are too far to qualify for TOD parking relief under the Connected Communities Ordinance.

The specific minimum number of spaces required for an RS-2 single-family use is in §17-10-0200 of the Zoning Ordinance (not retrieved here).

**Verify:** §17-10-0600 [4]; parking minimums at §17-10-0200.

---

### 6. Coach House / ADU on This Lot?

**No — this parcel is not in an ADU-Allowed RS Area** [1]. Under [5], a building permit for a new coach house in an RS-designated lot may not be issued unless it complies with §17-7-0570 [5][1], which establishes designated ADU-Allowed RS Areas. This parcel is not in one of those designated areas [regulatory data]. Therefore, a new coach house cannot be permitted here under current rules.

Additional coach house standards that would apply if the designation ever changes [5]:
- Maximum height: 22 feet
- Minimum 3-foot open space unobstructed to the sky between the coach house and at least one side property line
- Accessory parking for the principal building may be reduced/waived via administrative adjustment
- Coach houses may be established without their own accessory parking

**Confidence:** High that ADU/coach house is currently not permitted here by right. Confirm via the Department of Housing ADU program map or contact DOH directly.

### Summary Confidence & Gaps

- **High confidence:** RS-2 zoning, no landmark/historic/PD/TOD/ADU/SSA overlays, ARO zone applicability, coach house ineligibility, two-flat not by-right.
